verdict.rationale: The UI documents many transactional services: entity formation, name reservation, periodic report filing, trademark registration and certificates of good standing. The only API evidence is a keyless, read-only business-entities dataset. The probe notes it is served from the Socrata open-data platform rather than the registry itself, so it is a host-platform data feed, not API parity with the filing UI. There is no evidence of any programmatic filing, reservation, renewal or certificate API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
